subject: general
question: Nayan can do a piece of work in 25 days. Tarun is 25% more efficient than Nayan. The number of days taken by Tarun to do the same piece of work is:
solution:
**Given:**

Nayan can do a piece of work in 25 days.

Tarun is 25% more efficient than Nayan.

**Formula used:**

Efficiency ∝ 1/Time

**Calculation:**

Efficiency of Nayan = 1/25

Efficiency of Tarun = 1.25 × (1/25)

⇒ Efficiency of Tarun = 1/20

⇒ Time taken by Tarun = 20 days

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
